receipts.detail: P1: Ordered participant commands applied identically across [1, 1] and [2] batch boundaries through the production proposal codec and applyCommittedEntrySliceTransaction, file-backed SQLite reopen with fresh PartitionService owners and absent volatile history, and rollback atomicity at the real transaction boundary.

P2: Synchronous generation history update inside the SQLite apply transaction, afterRollback volatile history reset, durable reconstruction of STATE.PREPARED and STATE.COMMITTED footprints and prepare-time generations on reopen, preservation across leadership change and >1,024 history eviction, primary-key and secondary-UNIQUE conflict coverage (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), schema-change fencing, contradictory historical PREPARED rows on reopen, and 3-replica native rs-raft participant group convergence.

P3: Collaborator validation in createReplicaPlacementOwner and attachReplicaPlacementOwner before side effects, fail-closed canAdmitRemove when workflowOwner is absent, and shared production binding via ControlPlaneSetup.attachReplicaPlacementOwner and PartitionService.setRebalancerLeadershipSink where detaching the binding breaks activation.

P4: Proposal identity minting via resolveEntryId(null), retaining one entryId and canonical body across OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and retryable pre-commit deferrals, new identity for new work and across owner reconstruction, SHA-256 command-fingerprint binding in _partition_statement_outcomes and in-flight pending map rejecting same-ID/different-command replay at both request and apply, and unresolved attempt reconciliation on leadership start.

P5: ES6-only strict own-data boundary validation, deep cloning and freezing of caller-owned nested inputs and outputs, direct and transitive (reachable: true) dependency-cruiser rules with synthetic negative witnesses, and P5 owner headers with regenerated source owner indexes and import graph.

Independent verification across P1-P5 by subagents 46ff33d8-eb27-4da1-bbf2-30a6752ea9f1, 28b525dc-a30b-43a1-88b1-c46a4d169e36, 3cd25c0e-8073-4377-a344-4a0246312509, and 21239293-3dcb-4494-b9b5-c0a57559b4b0.
